citizen_question: Main bataidar hoon, zameen mere naam pe nahi hai, 2 acre batai pe leta hoon. Kya mujhe Kisan Samriddhi ka paisa mil sakta hai?
resolution: Haan, mil sakta hai. Agar aapke paas tenancy agreement (batai anubandh) hai, toh aap Kisan Samriddhi Yojana mein farmer maane jaate ho. Agreement khatauni ki jagah accept hota hai. 2 acre limit ke andar hai (0.5 se 5 acre). Household income ₹3,00,000 ya kam honi chahiye. Agreement, income certificate aur bank passbook lekar service centre jaiye, apply karna free hai.
